open.title: Public deployment lacks configured hosting credentials
open.detail: PUBLISH_SITE is NOT_CONFIGURED: missing valid enabled Cloudflare configuration and a private Cloudflare credential file with mode 0600. Existing CLI presence does not establish authenticated hosting. A review bundle is being prepared; publication also requires independent approval of the exact digest. No deployment has been attempted or claimed.
open.expected_gain: Enable a publicly verifiable product demonstration and a measurable demand experiment.
